name: After § 23
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Türkiye
part_text: 23a. Condemns the unlawful arrest of Esila Ayık, a Ghent-based photography student detained on 8 April 2025 during protests in Istanbul; expresses concern over her untreated heart and kidney conditions; urges the Turkish Government to release her immediately and allow her return to Belgium;
